reference.title: Scenario 2 — Graphical Task
reference.shortdesc: Consider a numbered procedure where the author has placed an inline image with a Caption-styled

section.p: Consider a numbered procedure where the author has placed an inline image with a Caption-styled paragraph inside a list item — for example, to show a button as part of a step.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Locate the Power Button [List Number]: 1. Locate the power button. [Inline image: power_button.png] [Caption]: Figure: Power button location

entry.codeblock: <task id="locate_the_power_button"> <title>Locate the Power Button</title> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd>Locate the power button.</cmd> <info> <fig> <title>Power button location</title> <image href="media/power_button.png"/> </fig> </info> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result: The presence of an image between steps does not affect task classification — for example, a diagram of a device with an arrow pointing to a component to remove. The converter preserves the image and caption as a <fig> structure, placed inside <step><info>, not inside <cmd>. The task body remains a single contiguous <steps> block.
